title: Bihar Police BPSSC ASI (Technical) Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 22 posts of ASI (Technical) in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless)
qualification: As per BPSSC ASI Technical Advt 07/2026 (technical/diploma criteria as notified)
ageLimit: As per Bihar Police / BPSSC rules for ASI Technical
selectionProcess: Preliminary Written Exam → Further stages as per commission
documentsRequired: Registration ID and DOB; printed e-admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open ASI Technical Admit Card link (Advt 07/2026)
3. Login at apply-bpssc.com admit card portal
4. Download and print hall ticket
5. Appear for prelims on 5 August 2026 with ID proof
shortDescription: BPSSC ASI (Technical) Admit Card 2026 out on 24 July for prelims on 5 August 2026 (Advt 07/2026). Download from bpssc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released e-Admit Cards for ASI (Technical) recruitment under Advt. No. 07/2026.

Preliminary written exam: 05 August 2026. Admit card available from 24 July 2026.

  • Posts: ASI Technical in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless)
  • Vacancies reported: 22
  • Apply period was 21 May – 21 June 2026
